schema_notes: cost.land_deed/mallet/marker_stake are always equal per plot (one 'LEM' count). Special plots additionally need cost.expansion_permit. Plot numbers restart in every section (they follow the wiki maps). confidence: confirmed | community | approximation | unverified. 'confidence' qualifies the cost; 'geometry_confidence' qualifies tiles/bbox/adjacency.

coordinate_system.description: Main-section tile coords (u,v). u = 0..52 runs parallel to the main road (screen: down-right), u=0 is the edge that touches the starting farm. v = 0..31 runs from the forest/cliff edge (v=0, screen top-right) to the main-road edge (v=31, screen bottom-left). In base-farm coordinates (X along road, Y toward road) u = X - main_x0, v = Y, where main_x0 = 48 (hypothesis H1) or 32 (hypothesis H2); see notes.
coordinate_system.grid_rows_v_then_u: main_section_tile_map[v] is a space-separated list of 53 two-digit plot numbers for u = 0..52

special_expansion_min_level.disagreement: wiki Expansion/Farm and the 2017 patch note say level 29 (historic value)

unlock_rule.value: A plot can be unlocked when it shares an edge with land you already own (start farm or an unlocked plot). Wiki wording: 'All plots can be unlocked starting at the top. Once a section has been unlocked all adjacent ones become unlockable.'

cost_rule.value: Each plot costs N land deeds + N mallets + N marker stakes (same N); special plots add expansion permits.

placement_on_locked_land.notes: locked plots are scenery full of natural trees/rocks; you can only drag items onto free owned land

notes: Subsection widths: the wiki 'Area' row says 17/8/15/13 x 32; measuring the wiki's own map image (internal plot borders snap to an integer grid at 17.42 px/tile, residual < 0.2 tile) gives 16/8/15/14 x 32. Both total 53 x 32 = 1696 tiles. The tile map in this file follows the image (16/8/15/14).

Release date of subsection 4 (plots 40-52): wiki text says December 2018, but File:Farm_Expansions.png showing all 52 plots was uploaded 2017-03-28 and the March 2017 patch notes mention 'many new regular farm expansion areas'. The December 2018 'more regular expansion areas' matches the across-road regular plots (File:Farm_Expansions_3.jpeg uploaded 2019-01-05).
Special-plot level: official support page says level 25; wiki Expansion/Farm says 29 (the March 2017 patch note value).

Wiki Expansion_Permit page contains stale counts ('47 special areas', '643 permits for 50 areas through summer 2021'); its 'after Spring 2023, 1345 permits' equals 59+169+587+530 and matches this file.

Base-farm size: Hay Day 1.5.42 (Jan 2013) client data (home.json for a new farm and ai.json for Greg's farm) both declare TileMapWidth=48, TileMapHeight=32. Expansions already existed then (since v1.3, Nov 2012). H1: the starting land is 48x32 and the main section occupies X=48..100 (full main strip 101x32). H2: the 48x32 map already contained subsection 1 (measured 16 wide), so the starting land is 32x32 and the full main strip is 85x32 (X=0..84). The new-farm start objects cluster around X~13-23, Y~11-22 (centre of a 32x32 square), which mildly favours H2. Unresolved - keep map size data-driven.

Footprint unit: in the 2013 data, fields, fruit trees, path tiles and fence pieces each occupy exactly one tile; two bush types are 1x2; production buildings are 2x2/3x3/4x4 in the same unit (wiki infobox sizes are consistent with free space around buildings in Greg's farm). Objects store only a boolean Mirrored flag (the in-game rotate); treating mirrored 1x2 bushes as 2x1 gives 0 overlapping cells vs 6 otherwise, so mirroring swaps W and H.

Across-road sections: plot counts, costs and dates are reliable (wiki tables); their tile sizes and exact placement relative to each other and to the road are NOT known. Adjacency for the 2015/2018 regular plots and the upper plots was extracted from the wiki images (approximation); adjacency for special plots is not provided.

Out of scope but exists: Expansion/Town (town plots incl. 15 beach plots added July 2026 near the Sanctuary) and Expansion/Fishing_Lake (fishing spots). See https://hayday.fandom.com/wiki/Expansion/Town and https://hayday.fandom.com/wiki/Expansion/Fishing_Lake.
